items.name: fade-in
items.title: Fade in
items.description: A Motion wrapper that fades its children in and skips that animation when the user prefers reduced motion.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number ticker
items.description: A spring count for a KPI that keeps tabular figures, announces the final value once, and shows that value immediately when reduced motion is requested.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated tabs
items.description: Tabs with a shared sliding indicator. Keyboard behavior comes from Radix Tabs.

items.name: stagger-list
items.title: Stagger list
items.description: Staggers the entrance of cards or rows with opacity and transform so the list keeps its layout, and skips the stagger when reduced motion is requested.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success check
items.description: Draws a checkmark for a saved form or a finished step and exposes the confirmation as a status message.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: A destructive button that confirms after a press-and-hold, with a one-action alternative for people who cannot hold, and a countdown instead of a moving fill when reduced motion is requested.

items.name: inline-loader
items.title: Inline loader
items.description: Dots, a bar, or a spinner for an inline loading status. Reduced motion keeps the status text and drops the moving graphic.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard and morphs the icon to a check or an error mark. The swap is instant when reduced motion is requested.
